scope: diagnosis only; no patch, engine, reference, estimator or scorer change. Renders are diagnostic (oscillator-2 starting phase only) and each is hash-recorded.

conventions.level: 20*log10 of the Blackman-Harris coherent-projection AMPLITUDE of one partial (windowed_tone_amplitude, the scorer's primitive); a full-scale sine reads 0 dBFS
conventions.ratio: the scorer's harmonic_signature ratio, partial amplitude over fundamental amplitude, dB
conventions.power_mean: sweep averages are means of amplitude squared, reported on the same dB scale
conventions.phase: psi = oscillator-2 phase minus twice oscillator-1 phase, degrees of oscillator 2; theta_j = j*psi at mix partial 2j; referenced to the window centre
conventions.window: on+0.30 s to on+0.55 s, the scorer's window; history: event 0 from reset, event 1 MIDI 43 after MIDI 36 released, event 2 MIDI 36 after MIDI 43 released 1.4 s earlier
